title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
title_zh: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析
title_primary: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析
title_secondary: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
authors: Mary Amiti, Sebastian Heise, David Weinstein
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.
abstract_zh: 关税不仅提高了其所征税的进口商品的价格，也抬高了国内生产的商品价格——这一效应在标准的汇率传导估算中大多被忽视。通过研究2025年美国关税，我们发现约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。这些估算相对于受关税影响较小的商品进行衡量，并保持总体经济条件不变。直接效应占这一增幅的64%，因为关税提高了某商品外国品种的消费者价格。其余36%则间接产生——关税提高了美国生产商使用的进口投入品成本，而国内生产商因面临来自高价进口商品的竞争减少而提高其加成率。直接效应传导迅速，因为关税几乎立即推高了进口价格，但间接效应需要九到十二个月才能通过供应链逐步显现。因此，关税对消费者的影响比仅考虑直接效应所暗示的更为显著且持续时间更长。

title: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
title_zh: 多重融资约束下的货币政策
title_primary: 多重融资约束下的货币政策
title_secondary: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
authors: Ander Perez-Orive, Yannick Timmer, Alejandro van der Ghote
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We revisit the credit channel of monetary policy when firms face multiple financing constraints. Our theory shows that the multiplicity of constraints dampens the transmission of expansionary policy to firm borrowing and investment notably but amplifies the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens (eases), the most (least) responsive constraint binds. Using U.S. firm-level data and exploiting a quasi-natural experiment, we find strong support for these predictions. Embedding the mechanism into a New Keynesian framework, we find that the drop in investment after contractionary shocks is twice as large as its increase following equally-sized expansionary shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了当企业面临多重融资约束时货币政策的信贷渠道。我们的理论表明，约束的多重性显著削弱了扩张性政策向企业借贷和投资的传导，但放大了政策收紧的传导效应。这种不对称性源于，当政策收紧（放松）时，最（不）敏感的约束起主导作用。利用美国企业层面数据并借助准自然实验，我们为这些预测找到了有力支持。将该机制嵌入新凯恩斯框架后，我们发现，紧缩性冲击后投资的下降幅度是同等规模扩张性冲击后投资上升幅度的两倍。

title: How the U.S. entity list affects firm breakthrough innovation: A perspective on knowledge depth and breadth
title_zh: 美国实体清单如何影响企业突破性创新：基于知识深度与广度的视角
title_primary: 美国实体清单如何影响企业突破性创新：基于知识深度与广度的视角
title_secondary: How the U.S. entity list affects firm breakthrough innovation: A perspective on knowledge depth and breadth
authors: Dandan Li, Yiling Zhang, Yuhua Li
abstract: Based on knowledge combination theory, we explore the effect of the U.S. Entity List on firm breakthrough innovation, using a research sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2022. Our findings reveal that the U.S. Entity List significantly inhibits these firms' breakthrough innovation. The U.S. Entity List lowers knowledge breadth while enhancing knowledge depth. However, as the impact of knowledge breadth on breakthrough innovation outweighs that of knowledge depth, the U.S. Entity List ultimately inhibits firm breakthrough innovation. Government innovation subsidies and supply chain integration capabilities of firms mitigate the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation. Additionally, we find that the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation is stronger in technology-intensive, regulated, and competitive industries.
abstract_zh: 基于知识组合理论，本文以2013至2022年中国A股上市公司为研究样本，探讨了美国实体清单对企业突破性创新的影响。研究发现，美国实体清单显著抑制了这些企业的突破性创新。该清单降低了知识广度，同时提升了知识深度。然而，由于知识广度对突破性创新的影响大于知识深度，美国实体清单最终抑制了企业的突破性创新。政府创新补贴及企业的供应链整合能力缓解了美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应。此外，本文还发现，在技术密集型、受监管及竞争激烈的行业中，美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应更为显著。

title: Cultural Momentum, Demographic Divergence, and Population Prospects in India, 2100: Son Preference as a Structural Driver of Fertility and Long-Term Projections
title_zh: 文化惯性、人口分化与印度2100年人口前景：子嗣偏好作为生育率的结构性驱动因素及长期预测
title_primary: 文化惯性、人口分化与印度2100年人口前景：子嗣偏好作为生育率的结构性驱动因素及长期预测
title_secondary: Cultural Momentum, Demographic Divergence, and Population Prospects in India, 2100: Son Preference as a Structural Driver of Fertility and Long-Term Projections
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Standard cohort-component projection models for India omit one of the most durable behavioural drivers of fertility: son preference operating through Differential Stopping Behaviour (DSB). This paper addresses that gap by introducing son preference as an explicit stratification dimension alongside education and urban-rural residence extending the Vienna School’s multi-dimensional demographic framework to include gender norms as a structural modifier of fertility. Using a relational Gompertz framework estimated from a 300-cell state-by-residence-by-son-preference-category-by-NFHS-round panel, we find that son preference raises TFR by 15.4 per cent net of all socioeconomic controls and shifts the fertility schedule toward older ages. A 10 per cent permanent reduction in DSB-driven fertility from 2021 yields approximately 50–60 million fewer people across 15 major states by 2100; an SSP2-style counterfactual places the full demographic cost at 426 million. Shift-share decomposition reveals that in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, cultural momentum defined as cumulative population divergence from the sustained gap between observed and structurally expected fertility operates alongside demographic momentum as a binding constraint. These results suggest that projection models conditioned only on development covariates may understate long-run population size in high-preference states.
abstract_zh: 印度标准队列要素预测模型忽略了生育率最持久的行为驱动因素之一：通过差异化停止行为（DSB）运作的男孩偏好。本文通过将男孩偏好作为与教育和城乡居住并列的明确分层维度，扩展了维也纳学派的多维人口学框架，将性别规范作为生育率的结构性调节因素，从而填补了这一空白。利用基于300个单元（按邦、居住地、男孩偏好类别和NFHS轮次划分的面板数据）估计的关系型Gompertz模型，我们发现，在控制所有社会经济变量后，男孩偏好使总和生育率（TFR）净提高15.4%，并将生育时间表向较高年龄推移。从2021年起，DSB驱动的生育率永久性降低10%，将使15个主要邦到2100年的人口减少约5000万至6000万；而SSP2式的反事实情景则显示，全部人口成本高达4.26亿。份额转移分解表明，在北方邦和北方邦，文化动量（定义为观察到的生育率与结构性预期生育率之间持续差距所累积的人口分化）与人口动量共同构成刚性约束。这些结果表明，仅以发展协变量为条件的预测模型可能低估高偏好邦的长期人口规模。

title: Learning and the Efficiency of Expert Referrals
title_zh: 专家推荐的学习与效率
title_primary: 专家推荐的学习与效率
title_secondary: Learning and the Efficiency of Expert Referrals
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Buyers of complex goods and services often rely on the advice of expert intermediaries who are themselves imperfectly informed about the quality of the available options. How well do these intermediaries learn about that quality and act on it? We study this question in the setting of referrals from primary care physicians (PCPs) to specialists, using data on 4.5 million joint replacement surgeries for Medicare beneficiaries. We first document substantial heterogeneity in specialist quality and costs within geographic markets, and we present design-based evidence showing that PCPs adjust their referrals specifically based on the outcomes of their own patients. We then employ a structural learning model of PCP referral choices to quantify the losses from informational frictions and to simulate possible reallocations with improved information. Beyond learning, the model also accounts for limitations on possible reallocations due to habit persistence and capacity constraints. We find that about one-quarter of patients would be referred to a different specialist in the absence of informational frictions, with small but meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
abstract_zh: 复杂商品和服务的购买者通常依赖专家中介的建议，而这些中介自身对可选方案的质量信息掌握并不完全。这些中介如何学习质量信息并据此采取行动？我们以初级保健医生（PCP）向专科医生的转诊为研究场景，利用450万例联邦医疗保险受益人的关节置换手术数据展开分析。首先，我们证实地理市场内专科医生质量和成本存在显著异质性，并通过基于设计的方法证明初级保健医生会依据自身患者的治疗结果调整转诊决策。随后，我们构建初级保健医生转诊选择的结构性学习模型，量化信息摩擦造成的损失，并模拟信息改善后的潜在资源再分配。除学习机制外，该模型还考虑了习惯持续性和产能约束对资源再分配的限制。研究发现，若无信息摩擦，约四分之一的患者将被转诊至不同专科医生，患者预后将获得微小但显著的改善。

title: Harmonising access and reinventing the procurement of innovative medicines in Europe
title_zh: 协调获取与重塑欧洲创新药物采购
title_primary: 协调获取与重塑欧洲创新药物采购
title_secondary: Harmonising access and reinventing the procurement of innovative medicines in Europe
abstract: Europe pays for innovative medicines through 27 uncoordinated national negotiations, generating access delays, cross-country pricing externalities, and a weak position vis-à-vis both pharmaceutical firms and US trade and most-favoured nation pressure. This column argues that Europe should procure innovative on-patent medicines through a single European negotiation that fixes one wholesale price for the entire Single Market, while reintroducing equity across member states through differentiated national contributions and side transfers. Decoupling what the innovator receives from what each country pays would end the pathologies of external reference pricing and parallel trade, restore Europe's bargaining power, and guarantee simultaneous access for all European patients.
abstract_zh: 欧洲通过27个缺乏协调的国家谈判为创新药物买单，导致患者获取药物延迟、跨境定价外部性，以及面对制药公司、美国贸易与最惠国待遇压力时处于弱势地位。本文认为，欧洲应通过单一欧洲谈判采购创新专利药物，为整个单一市场设定统一的批发价格，同时通过差异化的国家缴费和横向转移支付重新实现成员国间的公平。将创新者获得的报酬与各国实际支付金额脱钩，将终结外部参考定价和平行贸易的弊端，恢复欧洲的议价能力，并确保所有欧洲患者能够同步获得药物。

title: Disconnected: The unequal impact of online learning on minority students
title_zh: 脱节：在线学习对少数族裔学生的不平等影响
title_primary: 脱节：在线学习对少数族裔学生的不平等影响
title_secondary: Disconnected: The unequal impact of online learning on minority students
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Online instruction holds the promise of expanding access to education for disadvantaged groups, yet it often deepens existing performance gaps. This study examines its impact on high-stakes exam outcomes, focusing on mechanisms driving differential effects for minority students. We leverage rich administrative data on students from five consecutive cohorts in 31 Israeli vocational colleges and the abrupt transition to online instruction during the COVID-19 pandemic. A key advantage of our setting is that exams were held in-person and graded centrally, ensuring comparability to pre-pandemic performance. Using a difference-in-differences design that compares outcomes within students and across cohorts, we find significant declines in both exam attendance and demonstrated knowledge following the switch to online instruction. These effects are not explained by local infection rates or childcare responsibilities, and are especially pronounced among Arabic-speaking minority students, regardless of their socioeconomic status. Drawing on variation in internet infrastructure, residential crowdedness, language of instruction, and prior academic performance, we show that poor internet access is a central mechanism underlying the adverse effects among minority students. For majority-group students, negative effects are concentrated among weaker students, suggesting widening disparities within the majority group. For minority students, the difference by prior achievement is not statistically significant, and if anything, the drop is larger for higher achievers.
abstract_zh: 在线教学有望扩大弱势群体接受教育的机会，然而它往往加剧了现有的成绩差距。本研究考察了在线教学对高风险考试结果的影响，重点关注驱动少数族裔学生差异化效应的机制。我们利用了来自以色列31所职业学院连续五届学生的大量行政数据，以及COVID-19疫情期间向在线教学的突然转变。我们研究设置的一个关键优势在于，考试以线下形式进行并由中央统一评分，确保了与疫情前成绩的可比性。采用双重差分设计，比较学生内部及不同队列之间的结果，我们发现转向在线教学后，考试出勤率和所展示的知识水平均显著下降。这些效应无法由当地感染率或育儿责任解释，并且在阿拉伯语少数族裔学生中尤为突出，无论其社会经济地位如何。利用互联网基础设施、居住拥挤程度、教学语言及先前学业成绩的差异，我们表明互联网接入不畅是少数族裔学生遭受不利影响的核心机制。对于多数群体学生，负面效应集中在学业较弱的学生中，表明多数群体内部差距在扩大。对于少数族裔学生，按先前学业成绩划分的差异在统计上不显著，甚至可以说，高成就者的下降幅度更大。

title: Bank concentration and SME borrower discouragement: the moderating influence of banking system stability
title_zh: 银行集中度与中小企业借款人受挫：银行体系稳定性的调节作用
title_primary: 银行集中度与中小企业借款人受挫：银行体系稳定性的调节作用
title_secondary: Bank concentration and SME borrower discouragement: the moderating influence of banking system stability
authors: Ginés Hernández-Cánovas Ana Mol-Gómez-Vázquez Pedro Martínez-Solano a Department of Economics, Accounting and Finance, Faculty of Business Administration, Universidad Politécnica de Cartagena, Cartagena, Spainb Department of Financial Economics and Accounting 等
abstract: This study uses a multilevel analysis to examine how banking system stability influences the relationship between bank concentration and borrower discouragement. The analysis uses 26 rounds of the Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises for 11 Eurozone countries between 2010 and 2022. We find that banking system stability reduces or even reverses the negative effect of bank concentration on borrower discouragement for small and medium-sized enterprises. Specifically, increased bank concentration reduces borrower discouragement when banking system stability, measured using the Z-score, is above certain thresholds: 20.6 for term loans and 21.97 for credit lines. These thresholds correspond to the 90th–95th percentiles of banking system stability in the data, meaning that only about 5–10% of firms operate in banking systems sufficiently stable for concentration to reduce discouragement. Micro firms benefit the most from bank concentration in stable banking systems but suffer the most in unstable ones. Additionally, increased bank concentration discourages credit line borrowers more than term loan borrowers in unstable systems, with the opposite effect in stable systems. Overall, maintaining banking system stability is essential for realizing the potential benefits of bank concentration, especially for small firms.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用多层次分析，探讨银行体系稳定性如何影响银行集中度与借款者受挫感之间的关系。分析基于2010年至2022年间欧元区11国企业融资调查的26轮数据。研究发现，银行体系稳定性能够削弱甚至逆转银行集中度对中小企业借款者受挫感的负面效应。具体而言，当以Z-score衡量的银行体系稳定性超过特定阈值时（定期贷款为20.6，信用额度为21.97），银行集中度的提高会降低借款者受挫感。这些阈值对应数据中银行体系稳定性的第90至第95百分位，意味着仅有约5%至10%的企业处于稳定性足以使集中度缓解受挫感的银行体系中。微型企业在稳定银行体系中从集中度获益最大，但在不稳定体系中受损也最严重。此外，在不稳定体系中，银行集中度提高对信用额度借款者的抑制作用强于定期贷款借款者，而在稳定体系中则呈现相反效应。总体而言，维持银行体系稳定性对于实现银行集中度的潜在效益至关重要，尤其对小型企业而言。

title: The impact of intelligent manufacturing on industrial pollution: firm-level evidence from China
title_zh: 智能制造对工业污染的影响：来自中国企业的微观证据
title_primary: 智能制造对工业污染的影响：来自中国企业的微观证据
title_secondary: The impact of intelligent manufacturing on industrial pollution: firm-level evidence from China
authors: Wen Wang Yingxue Sun Zhichen Huang a School of Economics and Finance, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Shaanxi, Xi’an, Chinab School of Economics, Fudan University, Shanghai, China
abstract: This paper examines the effects of intelligent manufacturing on pollution emissions in China’s manufacturing sector. Using firm-level tax administrative survey data and a staggered difference-in-differences design, we exploit the spatial and temporal variation in robot park establishment as a quasi-natural experiment. We show that intelligent manufacturing contributes to the pollution emissions reduction. This effect operates through two primary mechanisms: technological progress effect, which improves total factor and labour productivity, and capital savings effect, which optimize energy consumption and reduce the intensity of fixed capital. Furthermore, the emission-reducing effects are more pronounced for large-scale, high-tech, and strategically emerging firms, with these effects further magnified in regions characterized by concentrated industrial clusters. These results provide critical insights into the complex trade-offs between achieving environmental objectives and maintaining industrial competitiveness in developing economies. abstract_zh: 本文考察了智能制造对中国制造业污染排放的影响。利用企业层面税收行政调查数据，并采用交错双重差分设计，我们将机器人产业园设立的空间与时间变化作为准自然实验。研究表明，智能制造有助于减少污染排放。这一效应通过两种主要机制实现：技术进步效应（提升全要素生产率与劳动生产率）与资本节约效应（优化能源消耗并降低固定资本强度）。此外，减排效应在大规模、高技术及战略性新兴企业中更为显著，且在产业集群集中的地区进一步放大。这些结论为理解发展中国家在实现环境目标与维持产业竞争力之间的复杂权衡提供了关键启示。关键词：环境规制 智能制造 发展中国家 地方性政策 JEL分类：Q53 O14 O33 致谢：作者感谢编辑及两位匿名审稿人的宝贵意见。文责自负。

title: Unconventional Fiscal Policy in Times of High Inflation
title_zh: 高通胀时期的非常规财政政策
title_primary: 高通胀时期的非常规财政政策
title_secondary: Unconventional Fiscal Policy in Times of High Inflation
authors: Mai Chi Dao, Allan Gloe Dizioli, Chris Jackson, Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas, Daniel Leigh
official: 官方在线 2023-09-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The surge in energy prices in 2022 has been a defining factor behind the increase in euro area inflation. We assess the impact of “unconventional fiscal policy,” defined as the set of fiscal measures, possibly expansionary, motivated by a desire to mute the effects of the increase in energy prices and to lower inflation. Overall, we find that these unconventional measures reduced euro area inflation by 1 to 2 percentage points in 2022 and may avoid an undershoot later on. When nonlinearities in the Phillips curve are taken into account, the net effect is to reduce inflation by about 0.5 percentage points in 2021-24, and keep it nearer to its target. About one-third to one-half of the reduction in 2022 reflects the direct effects of the measures on headline inflation, with much of the remainder reflecting the lower pass-through to core inflation. The fiscal measures were deficit-financed but had limited effects on raising inflation by stimulating demand and instead modestly helped to stabilize longer-term inflation expectations. Looking ahead, the prospective decline in inflation in the euro area is partly due to fortunate circumstances, with energy prices falling from their 2022 peaks and their pass-through effects fading, and with less economic overheating than in economies such as the United States. Implementing similar measures in the face of a more persistent increase in energy prices, or in a more overheated economy, would have caused a more persistent rise in core inflation.
abstract_zh: 2022年能源价格飙升是欧元区通胀上升的关键因素。我们评估了"非常规财政政策"的影响——这类政策指旨在缓解能源价格上涨冲击并降低通胀的财政措施（可能具有扩张性）。总体而言，我们发现这些非常规措施在2022年使欧元区通胀降低了1至2个百分点，并可能避免后续通胀过度回落。若考虑菲利普斯曲线的非线性特征，这些措施在2021-2024年间的净效应是将通胀降低约0.5个百分点，使其更接近目标水平。2022年通胀降幅中约三分之一至二分之一来自措施对整体通胀的直接影响，其余大部分则源于对核心通胀传导效应的减弱。这些财政措施虽通过赤字融资，但通过刺激需求推高通胀的效应有限，反而适度有助于稳定长期通胀预期。展望未来，欧元区通胀预期下降部分源于有利条件：能源价格从2022年峰值回落且传导效应减弱，同时经济过热程度低于美国等经济体。若在能源价格更持续上涨或经济更过热的情况下实施类似措施，将导致核心通胀更持久地上升。
